name: annotate_variant_multi_source
description: Annotate a genetic variant from ClinVar, gnomAD, CIViC, and UniProt in a single call. Returns pathogenicity classification, population constraints, clinical evidence, and protein function. Use when you need comprehensive variant interpretation from multiple databases at once.

variant.description: Variant name (e.g., 'BRAF V600E', 'TP53 R175H'). Gene symbol + amino acid change.

gene.description: Gene symbol (e.g., 'BRCA1'). Used for gnomAD/CIViC lookup.

return_schema.description: Unwrapped payload (result['data']) of a successful call.

sources_queried.description: Subset of clinvar, gnomad, civic, uniprot that were actually queried (a source is skipped entirely if no gene could be resolved).

clinvar_classification.description: Present when ClinVar returned gene-level variants; null when none matched the queried variant exactly.

clinvar_classifications.description: Present only when multiple distinct classifications matched (e.g. a multi-allelic rsid).

clinvar_note.description: Present only to explain an ambiguous or missing exact ClinVar match.

gnomad_gene_id.description: Present only when gnomAD returned gene data.

civic_variants_matched.description: Present only when CIViC matched at least one variant.

annotations.description: Per-source parsed results, keyed by source name (clinvar, gnomad, civic, uniprot); a source is present only if it was queried, and its inner shape differs per source (or may fall back to {"raw": "<string>"} on an unparseable response).

clinvar.description: Typically {total_gene_variants, matched, exact_match, variants: [{name, classification, review_status}]}.

gnomad.description: Typically {gene_id, symbol, name, chromosome, canonical_transcript}, or {} if gnomAD had no record.

civic.description: Typically {total_gene_variants, matched, exact_match, variants: [{name, civic_id, feature}]}.
